recipe.select: highest dev greedy top-1 macro (exact reference agreement, NFC), then lower dev mean CER, then earlier update
recipe.input: lower-cased English word as UTF-8 bytes + EOS (unchanged from E06); no pronunciation, no prefix
fixes: max_new_tokens 121 with a no_eos status (latent E06 defect)
LoRA wrapper exposes the frozen base weight so FFN layers can be adapted
metrics: top-4 oracle at equal beam-4 budget
distinct top-1 and most frequent share
recipe.rationale: From the audit and the passed tiny gate: the pipeline can learn input-dependent outputs, so E06's collapse is an adaptation limitation. Kept from the tiny diagnostic: FFN + attention adapters (capacity; PEFT notes all-linear targeting can approach full fine-tuning) and lr 1e-3. Changed from E06: FFN targets, 3x the updates and 2x the batch (about 43 epochs vs 7) so cross-attention has time to learn the mapping before the schedule decays. Kept from E06 for generalisation on 2,255 noisy mined pairs: base dropout 0.1 and adapter dropout 0.05 (zero dropout was only for memorisation). Linear decay to 0 after a 100-update warm-up.

init: pinned google/byt5-small base + fresh LoRA adapter (seed 0); not initialised from E08/E10

exposure.sampling: row-level: each epoch a seeded permutation of all optimisation rows (E07's e07.fit default); a word with k spellings is drawn k times per epoch; no source weighting

guard: stop (resumable) after 3 consecutive readings with process RSS > 6.5 GiB or MemAvailable < 0.4 GiB
selection: dev greedy top-1 macro, then lower dev CER, then earlier update; checkpoints 600/1200/1800/2400/3000

splits: eval (historical, examined since E03, unreviewed refs)
evaluation.error_kinds: e10.error_kind against the closest reference (vowels_only, marks_only, consonants_changed, consonant_added, consonant_dropped, both)
evaluation.missing_ending: the prediction's consonant skeleton is a proper prefix of the closest reference's, or a candidate ended without EOS

decision_rule.primary: E11 greedy − E07 greedy on the historical eval split (paired family bootstrap, 10,000, seed 20261027)
decision_rule.useful_real_data_only_candidate: eval exact-agreement difference CI lower bound > 0 and eval CER not higher (CER-reduction point estimate ≥ 0); dev top-1 not below E07's
decision_rule.regression_relative_to_e07: eval difference CI upper bound < 0, or point ≤ −3.0 points with eval CER higher
decision_rule.note: classification of historical reference agreement only; phonetic quality and publication permissions are reported separately; no tuning after evaluation
